title: genista elata
intro: Genista elata, commonly known as Scotch broom, is a flowering plant in the legume family. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Genista elata include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
